avis.titre: Does what it says it will do....

The cream definitely left my skin super soft and hydrated when I woke up in the morning, but after 2 weeks of using it, I noticed a bunch of clogged pores all over my chin :( I have acne prone skin so I wouldn't say this cream is acne friendly.

I have come to love the Naturium brand ever since I received one of their products in a monthly subscription box. Naturium products a high quality clean products that actually deliver results. The proce point is very good and their products work just as well as higher price point products, so when I needed a nighttime moisturizer that was clean, result oriented, and reasonablly priced, I turned to Naturium. I was not disappointed! Their Intense overnight Cream is extremely hydrating and it sinks right into your skin. I have very dry skin and this product delivered real results for me. My skin does ot feel tight or look flakey when I wake up. It looks glowey andhydrated. Another great product from Naturium!

I am so thankful I found this skin care line and I hope Ulta will never stop carrying it because I'll be a forever customer. I'm 67 and my skin is as soft as babies skin! I couldn't be more pleased!

avis.titre: High quality without the price tag

Saved my skin last winter from dryness. I repurchased but find i dont need it as much in the summer. Put on as last step of skincare routine at night. Wash off in the morning.

This product works great for my dry skin. I use tretinoin and it really helps with the peeling side effect. This moisturizer also makes a great base layer under my concealer. My under eyes are super dry and it helps me avoid those wrinkles look less obvious.

avis.titre: I turn to it time and time again

Heavy layer at night and I wake up with baby soft skin. This product is not sticky at all like Naturium's Marshmallow Root one. There is nothing I would change about it.

avis.titre: Love it, love everything about it!

I have been on accutane for the last 4 months now and after month 3 I started getting extremely dry and red, irritated skin. This was all new for me since I'm typically crazy oily (but that's just the meds doing its job!). I had been searching far and wide for a night time occlusive that is also very calming, but friendly for very sensitive/reactive skin. This cream is PERFECT. I would describe it as a balm/cream hybrid. It has no fragrance, no essential oils, is very silky, and I wake up with beautiful hydrated and calmed skin. I think any of the bad reviews are focused on the texture and maybe need to apply it differently. Start with your normal skincare routine and use a regular moisturizer (I use Cerave lotion). Then as your last step apply this product to seal everything in. Take out a small dollop and warm the product up between your fingers until it starts to smooth. Dab little dots all over your face and lightly rub in. I use this every night now as my skin is very dry, but I can imagine this cream would be helpful to people even with combo/oily skin as its not super greasy. Maybe just once or twice a week as a nice hydrating mask. I cant wait to try other products once I'm finished with my treatment!!

avis.titre: A little too thick for me

I have 50+ year old skin that is dry if it is not moisturized regularly and usually only breaks out if it reacts to a product. My skins long time favorite moisturizers were recently reformulated and no longer worked to moisturize it. This left me searching for products that provide enough moisture and don't cause breakouts. The search left me with a few blemishes and skin that looked dull. I was not use to my skin looking that way. To me, it's early to write a review after trying a product. However, after just two applications of the intense overnight sleeping cream, I was really surprised to see my skin begin to go back to looking vibrant and moisturized with no irritation. The texture is different--like nothing I've ever used on my skin before. It's like a marshmallow or marshmallow cream. But it doesn't leave my skin sticky or overly oily, just nicely moisturizered. I personally like it in combination with the Niacinamide and hyaluronic serum and squalane oil. Unless I have unforeseen issues, I plan to continue using this lovely cream.

avis.titre: Game changer for Acne prone skin!

This is a list on your skincare routine!!! My skin feels so hydrated and plump the next morning EVERY time I use it, especially when I use retinol! A game changer!
